title: Client-actual cost evidence record
description: The external client cost-feed contract the margin capability consumes per pricing key. Only a genuine externally owned, client-attested ledger carries costProvenance = client_actual AND costEvidenceClass = client AND costAllowedUse = pricing_margin; the resolver requires all three, so a costEvidenceClass = synthetic_test record can prove parsers and negative gates but never resolves to a served margin value or an active price_margin selection. The generated pipeline stamps generated_source_native and can never satisfy this contract. These camelCase feed fields are the external wire contract; a future ingestion adapter (NOT YET IMPLEMENTED) must map them onto the internal snake_case inventory-context row the resolver reads (cost_provenance, cost_evidence_class, cost_allowed_use, client_actual_cost_minor, ...). Until that adapter exists no feed crosses this boundary, so the two field-name conventions are intentionally distinct rather than reconciled. Resolution is evaluated in the clientActualCost precedence order defined in reason-codes.json; the first failing check is the withheld reason.

costProvenance.description: Ownership marker. Only client_actual is eligible for the margin capability; every other value resolves to COST_NOT_CLIENT_ACTUAL. Ownership is an external fact and cannot be conferred by a generated profile, source instance, or policy amendment.

costEvidenceClass.description: Origin discipline. client denotes a genuine externally attested feed that may activate price_margin after approval; synthetic_test denotes a structurally equivalent fixture that may prove parsing and rejection paths but must never activate the live capability.

costOwnershipStatus.description: active admits the record; revoked resolves to COST_OWNERSHIP_REVOKED so a withdrawn client authorisation cannot keep serving margin.

clientActualCostMinor.description: Unit cost in minor currency units. Must be strictly positive; null or non-positive resolves to COST_MISSING or COST_NON_POSITIVE.

costCurrencyCode.description: ISO 4217 currency of the cost ledger. Must equal the operating price currency; otherwise COST_CURRENCY_MISMATCH. Cost is never silently converted.

costScopeMarketId.description: Market the cost record applies to. Must match the pricing key market or COST_SCOPE_MISMATCH.

costScopeLocationId.description: Location/store the cost record applies to. Must match the pricing key store or COST_SCOPE_MISMATCH.

costMethod.description: Cost method. WAC is computable directly. FIFO requires costMethodVerified = true against receipt-layer depletion; an unverified FIFO label resolves to FIFO_NOT_VERIFIED. Any other method resolves to COST_METHOD_UNSUPPORTED.

costMethodVerified.description: Whether the stated method has been independently verified against receipt/batch depletion. Required true for FIFO.

costKnownAsOf.description: Row-level observation/effective time of the cost. Must be no later than the decision origin (else COST_AFTER_DECISION_ORIGIN) and within the frozen freshness envelope (else COST_STALE). The inventory manifest cutoff is only an upper-bound fallback, never a substitute for this row-level time.

costAsOf.description: Decision-origin bound carried from the accepted inventory snapshot. Used as a temporal fallback only when an explicit decision origin is not supplied.

costSourceSystem.description: Raw source system identity of the client cost feed, retained for audit.

costSourceInstance.description: Raw source instance identity of the client cost feed, retained for audit.

costAllowedUse.description: Attested allowed-use purpose of the client cost. Must be pricing_margin for the margin capability; the resolver refuses any other or absent value as COST_NOT_CLIENT_ACTUAL.
